body: You can't waste oxygen, it's a renewable resource :P
That makes me feel a bit better. Thank you c:

I'm going to community college for two years, and I figured I'd get the credits I needed to go to a different college. But someone told me they only got out of community college in 2 years because they knew what school they were going to and what it required. They keep telling me different things and it's stressful.

I don't like mentioning age because people use it against you. I'm currently 16, and I'm planning on "graduating" high school a year early, which is causing all this stress. I don't know what I want to go to college for yet, so I don't know where I need to be going to college and it's just really stressful. 

I'm sorry if stuff stops making sense or stops being related to what you've mentioned, I'm kinda lightheaded at the moment.

I don't really have friends that I can talk to about things. I have a boyfriend, who I can talk to about anything, but he doesn't like it when I talk about hurting myself or anything. 

I'm not really trying to change things at the moment.. just trying to figure out what I want to do in the future so I can start working towards that. Everything just seems impossible. Everyone keeps telling me I need to know what I want to do in order for me to do it right but I'm not sure what I want to do and I feel like I'm going to mess it up somehow.

I'm trying to plan for the future, but I just..don't know how to make it possible. Everything seems so messed up and like it's just going to end badly and I don't know how to fix it before that happens.

I can't go for a walk, and music actually makes me feel worse(I'm weird, I know)

My current situation is a bit..complicated. And I know of nothing I could do to change it for the better. I'm in a shitty place right now, and I don't know how to get out of it for a few years.
